notes.content:

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Game engine update.
[*]Interface update.
[*]Added hints during the match.
[*]Fixed bug with particles under the field.
[*]Fixed bug with out of sync.
[*]Optimization.
[*]Fix bug with scrolling through server list.
[*]Fixed bug with delay in displaying updates in the server list.
[*]Added links to social networks.
[/list]
